classification.difficultyReason: Construct a grouped frequency table using prescribed intervals and combine its frequencies.

inlines.text: The number of runs scored in each innings by a batsman throughout a cricket season was:

children.label: a
children.prompt: Present this information in a frequency table using class intervals 0–9, 10–19, 20–29, ...

inlines.text: Count each innings once in its class interval. Include the empty 80–89 class.

children.label: b
children.prompt: On how many occasions did the batsman score:

answer.worked: The classes 50–59, 60–69, 70–79, 80–89 and 90–99 have a combined frequency of $2+2+3+0+2=9$ occasions.
The frequency of the 0–9 class is 7, so there were 7 occasions.
The classes from 0–9 through 70–79 have a combined frequency of $7+6+3+2+3+2+2+3=28$ occasions.
Include both endpoints. The classes 20–29, 30–39, 40–49 and 50–59 have a combined frequency of $3+2+3+2=10$ occasions.
